name: cancel_deployment
description:
Cancel an in-progress deployment, stopping its build before it completes. Fails if the deployment is no longer cancelable (already `READY`, `ERROR`, or `CANCELED`). Returns the updated deployment with `readyState: 'CANCELED'`.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v12/deployments/{id}/cancel --method PATCH. Fill placeholders from inputs.

id.description: The unique identifier of the deployment.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
